p2g1.instruction: Complete the table below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the Reading Passage for each answer.
p2g1.body: Time, Destination, Traveler and Purpose table. Classical era, Egypt and Anatolia, Herodotus: Purpose is 'To obtain information on [[14]]'. 1st century BC, Central Asia, Zhang Qian: Purpose is 'To seek [[15]]'. Roman Empire, Mediterranean, Ptolemy, Strabo and Pliny the Elder: Purpose is 'To gather [[16]]'. Post-classical era, Eastern Hemisphere, Muslims: Purpose is 'For business and [[17]]'. 5th to 9th centuries CE, India, Asian Buddhists: Purpose is 'To study with [[18]] and for spiritual enlightenment'. Early modern era, distant places of the globe, the Europeans: Purpose is 'To meet the public's expectation for the outside'. 19th century, Asia and Africa, Colonial administrator: Purpose is 'To provide information on the [[19]] they conquer'. By the mid-century of the 1800s, Europe and the United States, Sun Yat-sen and Fukuzawa Yukichi: Purpose is 'To learn [[20]] for the reorganization of their societies'. 20th century, Mass tourism, People from [[21]] countries: Purpose is 'For entertainment'.
